from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCurrentAssets(BaseModel):
    """One company's current assets information from its 2024 Q1 financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code if available in the report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    current_assets_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total current assets amount as reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, typically 'yuan' or '元'")
    as_of_date: str | None = Field(description="Date the balance sheet amount is as of")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line or excerpt containing the current assets amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_current_assets: list[CompanyCurrentAssets]
